word_ranking: Morph-it lemma frequencies estimated from subtitle word forms; ambiguous forms split in proportion to square root of each candidate lemma surface frequency. Descending estimates after lexical quality filters. This is not a universal ranking.
sentence_ranking: First 1000 unique short, everyday, directly Tatoeba-paired Italian sentences surviving the filters, ordered by descending OpenSubtitles2018 occurrence count.
